title: Practice 1: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Look! The airplane is taking off.
exercises.why: **взлетает** is the present tense (3rd person singular) of **взлетать** (to fly up, to soar, to take off, to take wing; (figurative) to zoom) — imperfective; its perfective partner is **взлететь**. present: я взлета́ю · ты взлета́ешь · он взлета́ет · мы взлета́ем · вы взлета́ете · они взлета́ют. — Wiktionary, «взлетать» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-** — Movement upwards. Antonym: с- Example: Альпинист взошёл на гору. — The mountain climber walked up the mountain. Prepositional phrases: в / на + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  The other choice: **слетает** (**слетать**) has the prefix с-, со- — Movement downwards.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Thus, the roots of motion verbs convey the lexical information of manner of movement, e.g. walking, crawling, running, whereas prefixes denote path, e.g. motion in and out of space. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0))

exercises.q: Пауки ___ (наводить / навести) на неё ужас.
exercises.why: **наводят** is the present tense (3rd person plural) of **наводить** (to direct (at), to aim (at), to point (at); to cover, to coat, to apply) — imperfective; its perfective partner is **навести**. present: я навожу́ · ты наводи́шь · он наводи́т · мы наводи́м · вы наводи́те · они наводя́т. — Wiktionary, «наводить» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**на-** — Movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion Example: Туча наползла на солнце. — A cloud crept onto the sun. Prepositional phrases: в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
